fields.Name: ORD-25 - Fulfillment
fields.Description: The shipping queue and the flip that closes an order (FU1-FU12). Fulfilment is a LOGISTICS fact, deliberately disconnected from revenue (D15) - no journal entry fires on Posted to Fulfilled, because revenue was settled at booking and releases on its own schedule. Letting shipping move the ledger would allow a warehouse delay to restate a closed period, so one check asserts the ledger is untouched. The case the bundle is built around is the MIXED order: one physical line and one subscription. Testing whether every line is Fulfilled passes every single-kind order and holds every mixed one open forever, because a subscription line never flips - it has nothing to flip. Only lines that CAN be fulfilled are allowed to hold an order, and reversals, bundle rollup parents and non-fulfillable product types are each excluded for their own reason.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: A confirmed order with a physical line appears in the queue with its pending count; an order whose lines require no fulfilment never appears at all and auto-advances; flipping the last shippable line advances the order to Fulfilled and it sticks; a partly-worked order stays open and reports how many lines remain; a MIXED order advances once its shippable lines are done rather than waiting on a subscription line that can never flip; a second flip of the same line is refused by name with the line identified; refusals are per line so good scans in the same batch still land and the order still closes; fulfilment writes NO journal entry; AllOrNothing refuses the whole batch and leaves every line untouched; a reversal line neither queues nor flips; a bundle rollup parent never queues while its components do; and a fulfilled order leaves the queue.
